root_cause: The manual recovery workflow treated a full content-loop transport timeout as a fatal step failure. GitHub Actions therefore skipped the already-bounded canonical per-channel publishers even when LinkedIn decisions were already content_ready. Recovery evidence was also written under a hidden .artifacts directory that actions/upload-artifact did not upload by default.
prevention_rule: Preparation may degrade, but provider side effects remain owned exclusively by the canonical publisher. Recovery must always attempt the bounded publish_only channel calls after preparation failure, then fail closed on canonical state readback. Recovery evidence must use a visible artifact directory.
